poll_interval.label: Poll interval (seconds)
poll_interval.description: How often the service re-reads VM state from libvirt.

connect_uri.label: Libvirt connection URI
connect_uri.description: The libvirt connection to manage, e.g. qemu:///system, qemu:///session, or a remote URI.

widget.tooltip: {running} running · {paused} paused · {total} total — click to manage

error.not_installed: virsh is not installed — install the libvirt client tools and reload the plugin.
error.connect_failed: Cannot reach libvirt at {uri}. Is libvirtd running? Check: systemctl status libvirtd
error.access_denied: Access denied to {uri}. Add your user to the libvirt group and re-login: sudo usermod -aG libvirt $USER
error.no_domain: No VM named '{name}' on {uri}. Check: virsh -c {uri} list --all
error.autostart_persist: Autostart only works for persistent (defined) domains — transient domains cannot be autostarted.
error.launch_virsh: Could not start virsh. Is the libvirt client installed?
error.launch_virsh_for: Could not start virsh for {action} {name}. Is the libvirt client installed?
error.console_failed: Could not open a console for {name} — is virt-viewer installed?
error.launch_viewer: Could not launch virt-viewer for {name}. Is virt-viewer installed?
